nodes.description: State variable marketingAddress: address payable public
State variable devAddress: address payable public
State variable liquidityAddress: address payable public
State variable _owner: address private; owner of contract
State variable _allowances: mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private
State variable boughtEarly: mapping(address => bool) public
State variable automatedMarketMakerPairs: mapping(address => bool) public
Function launch: external onlyOwner initializes Uniswap and enables trading
Function enableTrading: internal onlyOwner enables trading and sets timestamps
Function _transfer: private core transfer logic with fees, limits, and anti-bot checks
Function swapBack: private lockTheSwap swaps tokens for ETH and sends to marketing/dev/liquidity
Function forceSwapBack: external onlyOwner forces swapBack if contract balance > 1%
Function swapTokensForETH: private swaps tokens for ETH via Uniswap router
Function addLiquidity: private adds liquidity to Uniswap pair
Function _tokenTransfer: private routes transfer based on exclusion status
Function _transferToExcluded: private transfer to excluded account
Function _transferFromExcluded: private transfer from excluded account
Function _transferBothExcluded: private transfer between excluded accounts
Function _getTValues: private computes tFee, tLiquidity, tTransferAmount
Function _getRValues: private computes rAmount, rTransferAmount, rFee
Function _getCurrentSupply: private computes current rSupply and tSupply
Function _takeLiquidity: private adds liquidity tokens to contract and updates swap mappings
Function calculateTaxFee: private computes tax fee
Function calculateLiquidityFee: private computes liquidity fee
Function removeAllFee: private sets fees to zero temporarily
Function restoreAllFee: private restores previous fees
Function _approve: private sets allowance and emits Approval
Function balanceOf: public view returns token balance
Function allowance: external view returns allowance
Function totalSupply: external pure returns total supply
Function excludeFromReward: public onlyOwner excludes account from rewards
Function includeInReward: public onlyOwner includes account back in rewards
Function excludeFromMaxTransaction: public onlyOwner excludes account from max tx limits
Function setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: public onlyOwner sets AMM pair
Function _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair: private sets AMM pair and exclusions
Function setGasPriceLimit: external onlyOwner sets gas price limit
Function reflectionFromToken: external view converts token to reflection
Function tokenFromReflection: public view converts reflection to token
Function removeLimits: external onlyOwner disables limits, gas limit, and transfer delay
Function disableTransferDelay: external onlyOwner disables transfer delay
Function removeBoughtEarly: external onlyOwner removes early buyer flag
Function excludeFromFee: external onlyOwner excludes account from fees
Function includeInFee: external onlyOwner includes account in fees
Function setBuyFee: external onlyOwner sets buy fees
Function setSellFee: external onlyOwner sets sell fees
Function setMarketingAddress: external onlyOwner sets marketing address
Function setLiquidityAddress: public onlyOwner sets liquidity address
Function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled: public onlyOwner toggles swapAndLiquify
Function receive: external payable empty receive function
Function transferForeignToken: external onlyOwner transfers foreign tokens
Function withdrawStuckETH: external onlyOwner withdraws ETH if trading not active
Function owner: public view returns owner address
Function renounceOwnership: public onlyOwner renounces ownership
Function transferOwnership: public onlyOwner transfers ownership
Unsafe low-level call to marketingAddress with ETH in swapBack
Unsafe low-level call to devAddress with ETH in swapBack
Unsafe low-level call sending leftover ETH to marketingAddress in swapBack
Unsafe low-level call sending ETH to msg.sender in withdrawStuckETH
